verdict.rationale: The evidence only implies that Justworks PEO offers health insurance: customers get quotes on 'the plans and pricing' available when joining, and are told they can terminate their current health insurance providers once their PEO start date is confirmed. Nothing documents how benefit enrollments are administered or how health insurance deductions flow into payroll. Recording fringe benefits provided outside Justworks is a different capability and is not credited. Missing for 10: documented benefits enrollment administration (open enrollment, plan elections, life events), payroll-synced premium deductions, an explicit description of the health plan offering, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can offer and administer health insurance with enrollments and deductions synced to payroll

citations.quote: we provide customized quotes that are reflective of the plans and pricing your company would have access to when joining Justworks PEO

you can let your current providers for payroll, EPLI (if applicable), and health insurance (if applicable) know that you are terminating your relationship as of the day prior to the confirmed start date
